derived_definitions.name: Instruction cache hit
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of read requests made that hit the data in the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

derived_definitions.name: Requests
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests made to the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Hits
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Misses
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Scalar cache hit
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of read requests made from executing shader code that hit the data in the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

derived_definitions.name: Requests
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code to the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Hits
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache hit from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Misses
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache miss from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: L0 cache hit
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of read requests that hit the data in the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

derived_definitions.name: Requests
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests made to the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Hits
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Ray-box tests
derived_definitions.description: The number of ray box intersection tests.

derived_definitions.name: Write size
derived_definitions.description: The total bytes written to the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

derived_definitions.name: Misses
derived_definitions.description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data, which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: L2 cache hit
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of read or write requests that hit the data in the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

derived_definitions.name: Requests
derived_definitions.description: The number of read or write requests made to the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Hits
derived_definitions.description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache hit from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Misses
derived_definitions.description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache miss from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU, including the Command Processor, Geometry Engine, all WGPs, all Render Backends, and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

derived_definitions.name: Ray-triangle tests
derived_definitions.description: The number of ray triangle intersection tests.

derived_definitions.name: LDS Bank Conflict
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of GPUTime LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

derived_definitions.name: Gpu Busy Cycles
derived_definitions.description: Number of GPU cycles that the GPU command processor was busy.

derived_definitions.name: LDS Busy Cycles
derived_definitions.description: Number of GPU cycles the LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0 (optimal) to GPUBusyCycles (bad).

derived_definitions.name: Memory unit busy
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalled). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account. Value range: 0% to 100% (fetch-bound).

derived_definitions.name: Memory unit stalled
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is stalled. Try reducing the number or size of fetches and writes if possible. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

derived_definitions.name: Memory unit busy cycles
derived_definitions.description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalledCycles). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

derived_definitions.name: Memory unit stalled cycles
derived_definitions.description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is stalled.

derived_definitions.name: Write unit stalled
derived_definitions.description: The percentage of GPUTime the Write unit is stalled. Value range: 0% to 100% (bad).

derived_definitions.name: Write unit stalled cycles
derived_definitions.description: Number of GPU cycles the Write unit is stalled.

derived_definitions.name: Fetch size
derived_definitions.description: The total bytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

derived_definitions.name: Local video memory bytes
derived_definitions.description: Number of bytes read from or written to the Infinity Cache (if available) or local video memory

derived_definitions.name: PCIe bytes
derived_definitions.description: Number of bytes sent and received over the PCIe bus
